name: Order (orders + order_items)
note: RET: Order, OrderItem. DET orders: id, customer_email, shipping_address, payment_method, status, total_amount, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at; order_items: plant_id, plant_name, quantity, unit_price (surrogate id and FK order_id not counted)

name: Plant (catalog-service)
note: DET: id, name, price, active; read only for price and availability

name: Stock (inventory-service)
note: DET: plantId, quantity, available, inStock; read only (fast-fail check)

name: Create order
note: DET: customerEmail, shippingAddress, paymentMethod, plantId, quantity, error message, 202 response; FTR: Order, Plant, Stock

name: Confirm order (payment-completed)
note: DET: orderId, paymentId, transactionId; FTR: Order

name: Cancel order (inventory-failed / payment-failed)
note: DET: orderId, reason; FTR: Order. Both topics run the same processing logic with the same DET/FTR -> one elementary process

name: Anonymize customer orders
note: DET: email, ordersAnonymized, error message; FTR: Order

name: View order by id
note: DET: id + 12 output fields incl. derived lineTotal + error message (404). Derived lineTotal = unitPrice x quantity -> EO, not EQ

name: Customer order history
note: DET: email + 12 output fields incl. derived lineTotal; FTR: Order

name: Export customer orders (GDPR)
note: DET: email + orderId, status, paymentMethod, totalAmount, shippingAddress, createdAt, plantId, plantName, quantity, unitPrice; no derived data -> EQ
